name: blackboxvtt
description: BlackBox VTT is a self-hosted Electron virtual tabletop for running secure, persistent multiplayer campaigns. It combines real-time scene editing, maps, fog, journals, chat, dice rolling, asset management, permissions, and D&D 5e/5.5e support.
author: Zain Gill

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
